extracted.intended_audience: elected and appointed county officials, county staff, and county leaders
extracted.subtask_description: A landing page aggregating NACo (National Association of Counties) resources: advocacy toolkits, policy analyses, program descriptions, webinars, and training intended to help county governments engage in federal advocacy, develop programs (e.g., housing), and build leadership capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guide for Developing Housing on County-Owned Land — five-step framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides counties with a practical, five-step framework for developing affordable housing on county-owned land, covering site selection, zoning review, financial feasibility, developer procurement and community engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights how counties can reduce development costs, leverage public assets and build community support to expand affordable housing production.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-Performance Leadership Academy — five essential skills
rubrics_metrics.description: The program emphasizes five essential skills: Lead, Organize, Collaborate, Deliver, Communicate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brief explanations on each skill as outcomes for participants: Lead — fostered cultures of accountability; Organize — managed complex organizational change; Collaborate — breaking down departmental silos; Deliver — drive better community outcomes; Communicate — effectively speak the language of the organization across diverse stakeholder groups. Attendees will gain actionable insights to apply high-performance strategies in their organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mental Health Awareness Month: County Participation Toolkit — advocacy priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Toolkit to showcase county behavioral health services and to advocate for key mental health reforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically highlights advocating for: repealing harmful exclusionary Medicaid policies, bolstering local crisis response infrastructure, supporting the behavioral health workforce, and ensuring mental health parity; intended to help counties effect significant change by both showcasing services and advocating reforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fixing Emergency Management for Americans (FEMA) Act: County Advocacy Toolkit
rubrics_metrics.description: Toolkit designed to help county leaders understand four of the top county policy wins that NACo fought to include in the FEMA Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how the provisions would impact counties and provides clear, actionable guidance on how counties can advocate for the bill's passage (framing, messaging, and advocacy steps implied though not enumerated on the landing page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Surface Transportation Reauthorization Advocacy Toolkit — outreach and engagement best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides tools and best practices to help educate and engage with Congress, the Administration and the public on the importance of county infrastructure and the need for direct federal support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended as practical advocacy guidance for county leaders to shape federal transportation reauthorization conversations; landing page summary does not list specific steps but frames the toolkit as a resource for outreach/education strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Reforms to Medicaid Financing: What Counties Should Know — impact analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource to learn about proposed federal reforms to Medicaid financing and their potential implications for county budgets and service delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames the resource as analysis for county leaders to assess budgetary and operational impacts and to inform advocacy and planning; specific evaluative criteria are in the linked resource rather than on the landing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webinar learning outcomes — elections and related legal/administrative parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Webinar on '2026 Elections: Local Government Roles and Responsibilities' provides an overview of new executive orders, federal policies, legal parameters, and legislative proposals local election administrators and leaders should understand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended outcomes include clarifying regulatory/administrative responsibilities and informing local officials on how federal actions may affect election administration; the page frames webinars as a way to gain actionable legal and policy knowledge.

rubrics_metrics.name: NACo EDGE program value-delivery criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: NACo EDGE delivers value-added, cost-cutting solutions to counties by evaluating their needs and harnessing the collective purchasing power of 3,069 counties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program offerings listed (e.g., Nationwide Retirement Solutions, Public Promise Insurance, Cooperative Purchasing, ClearGov, Budget & Planning Solutions, etc.) imply criteria for successful county engagement: needs assessment, procurement/partnership mechanisms, leveraging scale for cost savings, and program-specific implementation support.
